# 学习目标

+ 能绘制简单条形图，并调整图形参数

+ 能绘制多变量条形图，包括并列条形图、堆叠条形图和百分比条形图

+ 能绘制矩形树状图并调整相关参数

+ 能绘制气泡图并调整相关参数

+ 能绘制词云图

# 用条形比较

# 用矩形比较

## 矩形树状图

### 案例1：居民人均消费支出

```{r}
library(treemapify)
p_treemap <- ggplot(data3_2_long, aes(
  area = 支出金额, fill = 地区,       #设置区域变量和填充变量
  subgroup = 地区, label = 支出项目   #设置亚组和标签
)) +
  geom_treemap(color = "white")+      # 设置区域分割线颜色
  geom_treemap_subgroup_border(color = "white", size = 5)+ #设置亚组边线颜色和线宽
  geom_treemap_text(place = "middle") # 设置标签文本位置
p_treemap
```

自定义调色板
```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
p_treemap + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  ggtitle("4个地区的消费支出情况")
```

### 案例2：网购调查情况

```{r}
data3_1_cal <- data3_1 |> 
  summarise(人数 = n(),.by = c(性别, 网购原因,满意度)) # 根据性别和满意度计算人数
```


```{r}
ggplot(data3_1_cal,aes(
  area = 人数, subgroup = 性别, subgroup2 = 网购原因,
  fill = 性别, label = 满意度
)) +
  geom_treemap(color = "white") +
  geom_treemap_subgroup_border(color = "white",size = 6)+
  geom_treemap_subgroup2_border(color = "white",size = 3)+
  geom_treemap_text(place = "middle")+
  geom_treemap_subgroup2_text(place = "topleft",size = 14,
                              color = "white")
```

# 用圆或点比较

## 圆堆图

准备数据
```{r}
data3_3_cal <- data3_3 |> 
  summarise(GDP=sum(地区生产总值),.by = c(地带划分,地区))
```

准备包
```{r}
# 实现从github下载包
if (!requireNamespace("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
library(remotes)
```
从github下载圆锥图相关的包
```{r}
#| eval: false
remotes::install_github("EvaMaeRey/ggcirclepack")
```
绘图
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(ggcirclepack)
ggplot(data3_3,aes(id=地区,area=地区生产总值,fill = 地区))+
  geom_circlepack(show.legend = FALSE, color = "grey")+ #设置边线颜色
  geom_circlepack_text(show.legend = FALSE) + # 绘制标签
  coord_equal()
```
根据地带划分分面
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
ggplot(data3_3,aes(id=地区,area=地区生产总值,fill = 地带划分))+
  geom_circlepack(show.legend = FALSE, color = "grey")+
  geom_circlepack_text(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_equal()+
  facet_grid(~地带划分)
```

## 气泡图
```{r}
data3_2_long |> filter(地区=="北京") |> 
ggplot(aes(x=支出金额,y=支出项目))+
  geom_point(aes(size = 支出金额),color = "steelblue")+
  scale_size(range = c(1,15))
```

# 用颜色饱和度比较

## 热图

## 案例1：支出金额
```{r}
ggplot(data3_2_long,aes(x=地区,y=支出项目,fill = 支出金额))+
  geom_tile(color="white")+
  geom_text(aes(label = 支出金额))+
  scale_fill_continuous(low="#FEE5D9",high="#EF3B2C")
```


### 案例2：网购情况

```{r}
p1 <- data3_1 |> summarise(人数=n(),.by = c(满意度,网购原因)) |> 
ggplot(aes(x=满意度,y=网购原因,fill = 人数))+
  geom_tile(color = "grey50")+
  geom_text(aes(label = 人数)) +
  scale_fill_continuous(low="#FEE5D9",high="#EF3B2C")+
  coord_fixed() #设置x轴与y轴的比例相等
p1
```

转换为极坐标热图
```{r}
p1+coord_polar()
```

# 其他比较方法

## 克利夫兰点图
```{r}
data3_3_cal2 <- data3_3 |> 
  summarise(GDP=sum(地区生产总值),.by = 地区) |> 
  mutate(地区=reorder(地区,GDP),         
         mean_GDP = mean(GDP),
         p_col=ifelse(GDP>=mean_GDP,"red","blue"),
         p_size=ifelse(GDP>100000,4,2),
         l_width=ifelse(GDP>100000,1,0.5))
```

```{r}
#| fig-asp: 1.4
#| fig-width: 5
data3_3_cal2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=GDP,y=地区))+
  geom_point(aes(color = p_col,size = p_size))+
  geom_segment(aes(y=地区,yend=地区,
                   x=mean_GDP,xend = GDP,
                   color = p_col,
                   linewidth = l_width))+
  scale_color_identity()+
  scale_size_identity()+
  scale_linewidth_identity()+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_GDP), color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "2023年各地区的地区生产总值的克利夫兰点图")
```

## 棒棒糖图

安装ggalt包
```{r}
#| fig-asp: 0.5
#| fig-width: 10
data3_3_cal2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=地区,y=GDP))+
  geom_point(aes(color=GDP))+
  geom_segment(aes(x=地区,xend = 地区,y=0,yend = GDP,color=GDP))+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mean_GDP),color = "red",linetype = 2)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.7))+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis", direction = -1)+
  labs(y="地区生产总值",
       title = "2023年各地区的地区生产总值的棒棒糖图")
```

极坐标棒棒糖图
```{r}
data3_3_cal2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=地区,y=GDP))+
  geom_point(aes(color=GDP))+
  geom_segment(aes(x=地区,xend = 地区,y=0,yend = GDP,color=GDP))+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mean_GDP),color = "red",linetype = 2)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.7))+
  scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis", direction = -1)+
  labs(y="地区生产总值",
       title = "2023年各地区的地区生产总值的棒棒糖图")+
  coord_polar()
```

## 哑铃图

数据准备
```{r}
#| eval: false
gdp <- read_excel("./分省年度数据-地区生产总值-最近10年.xlsx",range = "A4:H35")
gdp <- gdp |> 
  mutate(across(2:8,as.numeric)) |> 
  rename(GDP_2025 = `2025年`,
         GDP_2024 = `2024年`,
         GDP_2023 = `2023年`,
         GDP_2022 = `2022年`,
         GDP_2021 = `2021年`,
         GDP_2020 = `2020年`,
         GDP_2019 = `2019年`) |> 
  select(1,2,8) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:3,
    names_to = "年份",
    values_to = "GDP_value"
  )
```

绘图
```{r}
#| fig-asp: 0.618
#| fig-width: 8
ggplot(gdp,aes(x=GDP_value,y=reorder(地区,GDP_value),fill = 年份))+
  geom_line(aes(group = 地区),linewidth = 0.8, colour = "grey50") + #绘制哑铃线
  geom_point(shape = 21,size = 2)+
  labs(y="地区",
       title = "2019年和2025年各地区的地区生产总值的哑铃图")+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title = NULL))+      #去除图例标题
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9,0.1), #设置图例位置
        legend.background = element_blank())  # 去除图例背景
```


## 词云图

准备包 ggwordcloud
```{r}
#| eval: false
install.packages("ggwordcloud")
```

绘图
```{r}
library(ggwordcloud)
set.seed(12)
ggplot(data3_4,aes(label=词,size = 词频))+
  geom_text_wordcloud(shape = "star",area_corr = T,colour = "steelblue")+
  scale_radius(range = c(1,25),limits = c(0,NA))
```

彩色
```{r}
set.seed(12)
ggplot(data3_4,aes(
  label=词,size = 词频,
  colour = factor(sample.int(10,nrow(data3_4),replace = T))
  ))+
  geom_text_wordcloud(shape = "circle",area_corr = T)+
  scale_radius(range = c(1,25),limits = c(0,NA))
```

自选图形

使用ggwordcloud包内部的图片
```{r}
set.seed(12)
ggplot(data3_4,aes(label=词,size = 词频,color=词频))+
  geom_text_wordcloud(shape = "star",area_corr = F,
                      mask = png::readPNG(system.file("extdata/hearth.png",package = "ggwordcloud",mustWork = T)),rm_outside = T)+
  scale_radius(range = c(0,20),limits = c(0,NA))+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red3",high = "red")
```

使用自选图片
```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
set.seed(12)
ggplot(data3_4,aes(label=词,size = 词频,color=词频))+
  geom_text_wordcloud(
                      mask = png::readPNG("./arrow.png"),rm_outside = T)+
  scale_radius(range = c(0,20),limits = c(0,NA))+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red3",high = "red")
```

# 在条形图上添加推断信息

## 简单条形图+误差棒
将宽数据变换为长数据
```{r}
data2_1_long <- data2_1 |> pivot_longer(
  cols = 3:4,
  names_to = "课程",
  values_to = "分数"
)
```
计算统计量
```{r}
data2_1_calc <- data2_1_long |> 
  group_by(课程) |> 
  summarise(
    n=n(),
    mean_分数=mean(分数),
    sd_分数=sd(分数),
    se_分数=sd_分数/sqrt(n)
  )
```

绘图，通过geom_errorbar添加误差棒
```{r}
ggplot(data2_1_calc,aes(x=课程,y=mean_分数,fill = 课程))+
  geom_col()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_分数-sd_分数,ymax = mean_分数+sd_分数),
                width = 0.5, linewidth = 1.2)
```

## 并列条形图+误差棒

```{r}
data2_1_calc2 <- data2_1_long |> 
  group_by(性别,课程) |> 
  summarise(
    n=n(),
    mean_分数=mean(分数),
    sd_分数=sd(分数),
    se_分数=sd_分数/sqrt(n)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(data2_1_calc2,aes(x=课程,y=mean_分数,fill = 性别))+
  geom_col(position = "dodge")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_分数-sd_分数,ymax = mean_分数+sd_分数),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 1.2,
                position = position_dodge(0.9))
```
